system.description:
You create a swirling vortex of air in front of you. You compress the air until the pressure implodes on itself creating a shockwave blocking attacks and reducing the lethality of attacks in your immediate area. All allied creatures in this jutsu’s radius gain 20 Temporary Hit points from the oscillating flow of wind until the end of the current turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and temporary hit points by 5.

trigger.text: 1 Reaction which you take when you or another creature within range would take damage.
